text.en: Grenade detonation has a brief blinding effect.
text.zh-chs: 榴弹爆炸可产生短暂失明效果。
榴弹爆炸可产生短暂失明效果。

text.en:
Passively grants -200 Blast Radius.

Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants within ? meters of the explosion are disoriented for ? seconds. (Effectively the equivalent of <arc/>Arc Blind without any of the elemental synergies)

Players near the explosion have their HUD removed, and screen whitened for up to ? seconds. Duration varies depending on the distance from the blast.
